title: Ethos Raises $22.75M Series A Led by a16z for AI-Native Expert Network
summary: London-based Ethos, founded in 2024 by James Lo (ex-McKinsey and SoftBank) and Daniel Mankowitz (ex-DeepMind), raised a $22.75 million Series A led by a16z with participation from General Catalyst, XTX Markets, Evantic Capital, and Common Magic. The eight-person company uses voice-powered onboarding for experts and AI matching of natural-language client queries, and told TechCrunch that about 35,000 people join its network each week. Ethos takes 30% or more as a per-project fee and says it is on track for eight-figure annualized revenue. TechCrunch named GLG, Third Bridge, AlphaSights, and LinkedIn as competitors.
whyItMatters: Top-tier venture capital is funding AI-native challengers that match on skills and capabilities rather than job titles, and that count foundation-model labs alongside hedge funds and PE firms as clients.
